expects.query:
Using the `/vss-setup-behavior-analytics` skill, end-to-end and autonomously, deploy the `vss-behavior-analytics` service on this host so that **ROI ENTRY/EXIT events are triggered when an object's BOUNDING BOX overlaps a region of interest** — rather than only when the object's representative point falls inside the ROI polygon.

**Environment & prerequisites:** A bare Brev host with Docker + `NGC_CLI_API_KEY` for image pull. `vss-behavior-analytics` is **CPU-only** (`gpu_count: 0`; `ANY` pool). A live broker / perception input is NOT required — verify the **deploy-time configuration** only (a restart-looping container is fine). Bounding-box-overlap ROI detection is supported ONLY for image-based (2D image-plane) calibration, so: provide an image calibration that defines at least one ROI, choose an app entrypoint that actually emits ROI events, and set the ROI detection mode to bounding-box overlap.
checks: `docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q vss-behavior-analytics` returns exit 0 (a behavior-analytics container was created)

`docker inspect $(docker ps -aq --filter name=vss-behavior-analytics | head -1) --format '{{json .Config.Cmd}}' | grep -qE 'main_analytics_2d_app.py|main_analytics_3d_app.py|main_public_safety_app.py'` returns exit 0 (an entrypoint that emits ROI ENTRY/EXIT events is used — it must NOT be main_search_and_alerts_app.py, whose behavior path does not run ROI/tripwire events)

The app config the container mounts sets `roiEventDetectionMode` to "bbox" (resolve/read the config via `docker inspect <container> --format '{{json .Mounts}}'` or by reading `/resources/*config.json` in the container).

A calibration defining at least one ROI is mounted (e.g. via `--calibration /resources/calibration.json`), and it is an IMAGE-based calibration — bbox-overlap mode is only honored for image calibration; on cartesian/geo the ROI check silently falls back to the coordinate-inside test (with a one-time warning), which would make the requested behavior a no-op.
